name: Suspected Malaria (fever)
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_diagnosis a
JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
  ON mdp.patient_id = a.patient_id
WHERE a.date_created >= ':startDate'
  AND a.date_created <  ':endDate'
  AND a.diagnosis_coded IN (116128,169846,168426)
  AND a.certainty = 'PROVISIONAL'
  AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
;
